name: sales-portal-monorepo
description: Sales portal for pricing and closing direct marketing contracts

scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/backend && npm run test -w apps/frontend && npm run test -w apps/pricing-service && npm run test -w apps/contracts-service
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w apps/backend && npm run test:coverage -w apps/frontend && npm run test:coverage -w apps/pricing-service && npm run test:coverage -w apps/contracts-service
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/backend && npm run lint -w apps/frontend && npm run lint -w apps/pricing-service && npm run lint -w apps/contracts-service
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run test:coverage
